meta.name: 13c-metabolic-flux
meta.description: Estimates intracellular metabolic fluxes from steady-state carbon-13 isotope-tracing measurements using validated atom maps, mfapy isotope simulation, constrained multistart fitting, and flux-profile diagnostics. Use for 13C-MFA, carbon tracing, mass isotopomer distributions (MDVs/MIDs), positional isotopomers, parallel tracer experiments, and determining whether labeling data constrain a pathway flux. Distinguishes measured-label inference from COBRA flux balance analysis and flags experiments requiring nonstationary MFA.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从碳13同位素示踪数据估算细胞内代谢通量,判断标记数据能否约束某条通路
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在做碳13代谢通量实验,却不清楚数据是否足以约束目标通路。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run carbon-13 tracing experiments and need to know if labeling data constrains a flux.

howto.what: 它用 mfapy 前向模拟和受约束多起点拟合,从稳态碳-13 示踪数据估计胞内代谢通量,并做通量剖面诊断,判断哪些通量被标记数据约束。结果写成 JSON,附模型与数据哈希、残差诊断。
howto.when: 当你做 13C-MFA、碳示踪或 MDV/MID 分析,或想判断标记数据是否约束某条通路通量时用它。它只支持代谢与同位素稳态;非稳态 MFA 会被标出,需另用专门引擎。

say.text: 用我的模型和测量数据跑一下 check,看原子守恒、示踪比例和边界是否可行。
say.note: 会检查原子数、片段、示踪比例和边界可行性。

say.text: 拟合这些 13C 标记数据,并对 v3 反应做剖面,看它是否被约束。
say.note: 每个剖面点固定该反应并重优化其他通量。

say.text: 先用给定通量向量模拟一遍标记分布,和参考值比一比。
say.note: 输出模拟的 MDV 结果,可对照参考值。

howto.what_en: It estimates intracellular metabolic fluxes from steady-state carbon-13 tracing data with mfapy forward simulation and constrained multistart fitting, and profiles which fluxes the labeling constrains. It writes a JSON result artifact.
howto.when_en: Use it for 13C-MFA, carbon tracing, or MDV/MID analysis, and to test whether labeling data constrains a pathway flux. It supports only metabolic and isotopic steady state, not nonstationary MFA.

say_en.text: Check my model and measurements for atom balance, tracer sums, and bounds.
say_en.note: Prints an input-check report of feasibility issues.

say_en.text: Fit these 13C labeling data and profile reaction v3 to see if it is constrained.
say_en.note: Each profile point fixes v3 and reoptimizes the rest.

say_en.text: Simulate labeling from a given flux vector and compare it with the reference.
say_en.note: Writes simulated MDVs to a JSON file.
